definitions.full: H4783. murdaph [ מִרְדָּה ] noun feminine dominion ; — as accusative of congnate meaning with verb חָשָׂ֑ךְ בְּלִי מִרְדַּת Isa 14:6 , construct before clause (Ges § 130d ; so most for מֻרְדָּף ᵑ0 q. v. below רדף ). מֻרְדָּף noun [masculine] persecution (si vera lectio) (formed like Hoph`al Participle ); — Isa 14:6 , but ᵑ7 Thes and most מִרְדַּת q. v.
